description: View and analyze KPIs from IBM Planning Analytics (TM1) live in Power BI (read-only). SmartCard Light enables KPI and performance monitoring directly in Microsoft Power BI with live integration to IBM Planning Analytics (TM1). Users get real-time read-only access to plan values, forecasts and comparison figures from the planning and analytics software. The solution combines modern KPI visualization with context-aware views and drilldown capabilities for data-driven decision-making. Note: smartCard Light is a read-only visual — writeback is performed via smartTable, smartChart, smartGantt or smartTI. Key features at a glance: Clear single-value display of KPIs, targets and forecasts Context-aware display that adapts to selections, filters and slicers Multidimensional views (e.g. by version, period, currency, business unit) Thresholds, traffic-light colors and comparison values for fast status recognition Read-only visual – live display from IBM Planning Analytics (TM1) smartpm Planning App (PLAPP) – Planning directly in Power BI with live connection to your planning and analytics software The smartpm Planning App (PLAPP) enables modern planning and forecasting directly in Microsoft Power BI — in real time.
